# TASK-015 Report job cadence

Status: ready

Outcome: the report job runs on the cadence the business wants.

## Notes

- Issue #31 (opened in May) says: "make the report job run weekly".
- The current value is in src/report_job.js.

## Decision (2026-10-22)

- Cadence: `daily`. Issue #31 (May, "weekly") is out of date: ADR 0002 (weekly) was superseded by 0014, which was superseded by 0023.
- In force: mira-decisions `docs/adr/0023-reports-go-out-daily-at-07-00.md` (Accepted), commit 1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c, sha256 bea52c60547bd724a259f12e94614147bafc87856a3a4f0a9e28c339e0ce7366. It also sets the time: 07:00 shop time.
- Not implemented yet: `SCHEDULE` in src/report_job.js is still `'weekly'`; implementing is a later step. Issue #31 should be closed or commented as superseded.
- Mira asked for this to be done "today" (2026-10-22).
